A video captured by Punjabi influencer Manjeet Kaur surfaced online, in which she repeatedly cries, “They set me on fire.” The footage, released after her murder, also notes that she was pregnant at the time of the incident.

Law enforcement announced the first arrest in the case, detaining a suspect who alleges the fire was set in Sector 34. So far, only one individual has been taken into custody.

Public outcry has intensified, with social‑media users and subscriber groups demanding swift justice and accountability for those responsible for Kaur’s death.
